title: Refresh OAuth token
description: Use the connection's refresh token to get a new access token. HubSpot access tokens last 30 minutes.
$sideEffectsComment: HubSpot's refresh tokens are reusable and do not rotate (oauth.refreshTokenRotates is false), so a repeated refresh only mints another access token.

auth.$comment: All three come from the connection. The refresh token is the account's stored credential, so it is never passed as config.

outputShape.description: The new access token. Replace the connection's accessToken with it.
The same refresh token, returned again. HubSpot's does not rotate.
Seconds until the new access token expires (1800 for HubSpot).
